basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and lore enthusiast based in the Pacific Northwest. I've been playing Warframe for a couple of years and love diving into the intricate backstories of each Warframe. When I'm not gaming, I enjoy collecting vinyl records and am a huge fan of retro RPGs like Final Fantasy. My typical online hours are evenings and weekends, as I work as a software tester during the day. Currently single and enjoying the freedom to explore my hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a deep understanding of Warframe lore, acquired through countless hours of gameplay and active participation in discussions on forums and subreddits. My background in software testing gives me a keen eye for detail, which I apply when analyzing game mechanics and narratives.
